role: Independent expert, production-plan.md section 5 steps 2 and 3 (blind solve, key check). Coach only; never published.
method: Each item was loaded from tools/mock/data/full-mocks.js with the pipeline loader (the vm window context scripts/explainers/build.mjs uses) and shown as served: stem and the five choices in bank order (tools/mock/full.js escapes the stem as text and does not shuffle). The extractor withheld correct, why, traps, src, stop and nights; only the field names were seen.

The served page was then rendered in Chromium at http://127.0.0.1:4107/tools/mock/full.html (FULL_1, Quantitative Reasoning): all 19 stems and choice sets match the loader text exactly, no item serves a figure, the calculator button is present, and the page raised no errors.

Answers, reasoning, concept, a family and a misconception for every other choice, and confidence were written to a draft and stamped (sha256 0ff3cf13d21d4434, 2026-10-30T09:09:03Z) before any key was read; the key comparison then ran by exact choice text.

Every number and every distractor route was recomputed in python with exact fractions where they apply (distribution, inequality test points, absolute-value scans, linear solve and back-substitution, fraction sums, scientific notation, order of operations, sphere measures, successive percents, Vieta and integer roots, powers, discriminants). No item serves a structure, so RDKit had nothing to check.
Families come from the closed list in scripts/explainers/families.js; missType follows the family. They are suggestions for the writer, who decides.
Bank why and trap notes were read only after the key check, to flag copy the writer should not lift (bankCopy) and to compare distractor routes (notes); nothing in the bank was edited.

process.note: The blind view never printed key, why or trap values. The draft hash and time are recorded above; the key check and the bank read came after.

summary.line: All 19 keys agree with the blind solve; no key dispute raised, so key-disputes.json is unchanged.
